conventions.nulls: null = value not available in the archive (never 0, never invented)
conventions.uncertainties: <col>err1 = upper (+) uncertainty (>= 0), <col>err2 = lower (-) uncertainty (<= 0), same unit as <col>; null when not reported (archive-calculated values never carry uncertainties)
conventions.limitFlags: flag: 1 = value is an upper limit, -1 = value is a lower limit, 0 = measured value (null when the value is null)
conventions.references: Every *_refIdx is a 0-based row index into references.json rows ([refstr, label, url, kind]); kind "calculated" = value computed by the archive (see https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html)
conventions.dates: ISO-8601 calendar dates (UTC date, no time of day); archive time-of-day components (no time zone given) are dropped
conventions.coordinates: ra/dec ICRS decimal degrees; epoch per position source (J2015.5 for TIC v8); not propagated
conventions.rowOrder: rows sorted by hostname (code-point order), then orbital period ascending (nulls last), then semi-major axis, then pl_name; a host's planets are contiguous
conventions.composite: PSCompPars values for one planet can come from different references and need not be mutually self-consistent (see docs)

descriptions.pl_name: Planet name (most commonly used in the literature); unique key
descriptions.hostname: Host star name; key into systems.json (hostname field)
descriptions.sy_snum: Number of stars in the planetary system
descriptions.sy_pnum: Number of confirmed planets in the system (counts planets of all stars of a multiple system, so it can exceed the number of rows with this hostname)
descriptions.sy_mnum: Number of moons in the system
descriptions.cb_flag: Circumbinary flag: 1 = planet orbits a binary star system, 0 = no
descriptions.pl_controv_flag: Controversial flag: 1 = confirmation status has been questioned in the literature, 0 = no
descriptions.discoverymethod: Method by which the planet was first identified (e.g. Transit, Radial Velocity, Microlensing, Imaging)
descriptions.disc_facility: Facility (observatory / mission) of the discovery observations
descriptions.pl_orbpererr1: Upper (+) uncertainty of pl_orbper, same unit (>= 0; null if not given)
descriptions.pl_orbpererr2: Lower (-) uncertainty of pl_orbper, same unit (<= 0; null if not given)
descriptions.pl_orbper_refIdx: Reference for pl_orbper (value, uncertainties and limit flag)
descriptions.pl_orbsmax: Orbit semi-major axis (for microlensing and imaging planets often the projected separation)
descriptions.pl_orbsmaxerr1: Upper (+) uncertainty of pl_orbsmax, same unit (>= 0; null if not given)
descriptions.pl_orbsmaxerr2: Lower (-) uncertainty of pl_orbsmax, same unit (<= 0; null if not given)
descriptions.pl_orbsmax_refIdx: Reference for pl_orbsmax (value, uncertainties and limit flag)
descriptions.pl_orbeccenerr1: Upper (+) uncertainty of pl_orbeccen, same unit (>= 0; null if not given)
descriptions.pl_orbeccenerr2: Lower (-) uncertainty of pl_orbeccen, same unit (<= 0; null if not given)
descriptions.pl_orbeccen_refIdx: Reference for pl_orbeccen (value, uncertainties and limit flag)
descriptions.pl_orbincl: Orbital inclination relative to the plane of the sky (90 deg = edge-on)
descriptions.pl_orbinclerr1: Upper (+) uncertainty of pl_orbincl, same unit (>= 0; null if not given)
descriptions.pl_orbinclerr2: Lower (-) uncertainty of pl_orbincl, same unit (<= 0; null if not given)
descriptions.pl_orbincl_refIdx: Reference for pl_orbincl (value, uncertainties and limit flag)
descriptions.pl_orblper: Argument of periastron (sign/reference conventions vary between references)
descriptions.pl_orblpererr1: Upper (+) uncertainty of pl_orblper, same unit (>= 0; null if not given)
descriptions.pl_orblpererr2: Lower (-) uncertainty of pl_orblper, same unit (<= 0; null if not given)

descriptions.pl_tranmid: Time of conjunction / transit midpoint, as a Julian Date in the time standard given by pl_tranmid_systemref

descriptions.pl_tranmiderr2: Lower (-) uncertainty of pl_tranmid, same unit (<= 0; null if not given)

descriptions.pl_rade_refIdx: Reference for pl_rade (value, uncertainties and limit flag)

descriptions.ps_sy_refIdx: System-parameter reference of the default parameter set (PS table, default_flag=1)
descriptions.ps_soltype: Solution type of the default parameter set: 'Published Confirmed', 'Kepler Project Candidate (q1_q17_dr25_koi)' or 'TESS Project Candidate' (the planet itself is confirmed in all cases)
descriptions.ps_pl_pubdate: Publication date of the default reference, ISO-8601 year-month (YYYY-MM) or calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD)
descriptions.ps_releasedate: Date the default parameter set was released by the archive, ISO-8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD)
descriptions.ps_rowupdate: Date the default parameter set was last updated in the archive, ISO-8601 calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD)
descriptions.sysIdx: Row index (0-based) of this planet's host in systems.json rows
